doc: Every .NET WebAssembly host shim in this repository: the C# [JSExport] glue between the browser and an engine. A shim is marshalling only — it forwards serialized messages to its engine and contains no decision, state or browser concept. scripts/check-architecture.ts requires every */*.Wasm/Program.cs under site/ and guests/ to be listed here (default deny), each to reference its engine, to contain no control flow, and to name none of `forbidden` or its own `applicationConcepts`. Repository-only: consumers declare no host shims to `limen verify` (see architecture/verify-parity.json). The Rust ABI shim (guests/minimal/rust/limen-minimal-wasm) is not a .NET host and is held instead by architecture/guardrails.json requiredGates.unsafeAbiCrates. Guardrail-owned.
